import asyncio
from robotblocks_runtime import *
from machine import Pin, PWM


pin_2 = Pin(2, Pin.OUT)

async def proceso_1():
    while True:
        for rb_repeticiones1 in range(3):
            pin_2.value(1)
            await rb_wait(0.2)
            pin_2.value(0)
            await rb_wait(0.2)
            await rb_yield()
        await rb_wait(1)
        await rb_yield()

async def main():
    await rb_run(proceso_1)

asyncio.run(main())
